## Exclusive features

### APT repository

For Debian/Ubuntu-based distros, add `cosmic-comp` to APT for automated updates :

```bash
echo "deb [trusted=yes] https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VibedByKaKi-cosmic/cosmic-comp/refs/heads/apt stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cosmic-comp.list
sudo apt update
sudo apt install cosmic-comp
```

### GitHub Releases

From the [latest release](https://github.com/VibedByKaKi-cosmic/cosmic-comp/releases/latest), download :

| Architecture \ Package type | DEB package                |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| **`amd64`/`x86-64`**        | `cosmic-comp_*_amd64.deb`  |
